title_zh: Culture and history — 第22节可背诵讲义
body_en: History is not only dates. It is choices people made in hard times. Read a short life story and note two decisions the person faced. Draw a time line with five key events in your own words. Remember: every city has many voices — listen for more than one.
body_zh: 历史不只是日期，而是人们在艰难时刻做的选择。读一篇短短的人生故事，记下那人面对的两个决定。用自己的话画五件大事的时间线。记住：每座城市都有许多声音——多听几种。
